_about: Zones where every subdomain is a separate customer's name, kept as shared suffixes whatever the zone's own popularity. Read by scripts/build_public_suffixes_in_top.py (scripts/build_top_domains.py calls it), which adds them to data/public_suffixes_in_top.json; every reader of that file sees them: the scorer (instant-safe refusal, _check_brand_on_hosting_tenant), the ML model's tenant features (versioned: model_meta.json feature_data, docs/THIRD_PARTY_FEEDS.md 'Sequencing'), the blocklist publisher's tenant guard, confirmed_threats.site_name, the extension's hostingTenantSuffixes and the phone's shared_suffixes.txt. Not data/hosting_platforms.json: its tenant_suffixes reach the served model at once, without the feature-data pairing. The 'registries' section is also read by the blocklist publisher (scripts/refresh_dangerous_domains.py build_blockset), and only there.

psl_operators._about: Registrable names (last two labels) whose Public Suffix List PRIVATE-section rules are all kept, rules the operator adds later included; ICANN-section rules are never taken from here. Until 2026-10-23 the file held them because Tranco's top 100k ranked these names (DNS traffic to the tenants counted for the zone). The licensed ranking drops tenant rows before it ranks a name (build_top_domains.fold), so a tenant zone's own name rarely ranks, and #284 lost these 235 names' 468 rules: trycloudflare.com, cloud.goog, jcloud.kz, playstation-cloud.com, ngrok.io, on.aws, us.kg, replit.dev, dynamic-DNS zones and more. The list is that diff: 5a3c0ffa^:data/public_suffixes_in_top.json minus the rebuilt file, private-section rules of the 2026-10-23 PSL only.

registries._about: Listed operators (psl_operators) that are domain registries, paid or free: one label under the zone is one registrant's own domain, delegated to name servers the registrant chooses, never a server or region the operator shares between customers. The blocklist publisher (scripts/refresh_dangerous_domains.py build_blockset) judges such a name like any registrable, so a feed's www. host or PROMOTE_MIN_SUBDOMAINS listed subdomains block it whole (cs-money.com.ru, awi.za.com, free-account.us.kg were blocked whole while these zones were missing from public_suffixes_in_top.json, 2026-10-23 review of PR #309); the zone itself is never listed or promoted. Every other tenant zone stays exact-only: under a hosting zone the next label can be a shared server or region (hnd1.zeabur.app, in1.cloudjiffy.net, msa.trafficmanager.net). Zones only a government body or a school may register in (gov.ru, edu.ru) are not here: a listed host there is a hacked site, not a phisher's own name. Delegation counts: 'dig NS' on 2026-10-23 for the names under the zone found in the four licensed feeds, Phishing.Database ACTIVE and the licensed top 1M (phishing names are often suspended since, so a low count is not against a registry).
